Definition: from G1021 and a prolonged form of G4126; to sail slowly:--sail slowly.
BiblicalUsage: bradyploéō means to sail slowly. It appears once, in Acts among them, and that use is enough to fix its sense.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe bradyploéō, little-used as it is, earns its place in Scripture.
